question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**describe**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a base form of the verb that fits with the phrase "used to".
 
• "**Describe**" is the correct option as the phrase "used to" is followed by the base form of a verb.
 
• Other options ("**describes**", "**described**", "**describing**") do not fit grammatically in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Describes: "Describes" is incorrect as it is the singular present form and does not fit after "used to".
 
• Described: "Described" is incorrect as it is the past tense form, which does not fit the context.
 
• Describing: "Describing" is incorrect as it is a continuous form, which does not align with "used to".
